name: CSO_RPT_QUESTIONS
description: Reporting table to be populated from cso_stg_questions. This table will contain the raw question data before aggregation.

columns.name: RPT_QUESTIONS_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: ID to track the contiguous usage of REST API from CSS for a given user session.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the user in CSO_USER_INFORMATION table.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the locale in CSO_LOCALE table.

columns.name: KNOWLEDGE_INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: The knowledge interaction ID is a unique ID for the length of the knowledge session. It is unique for the life of a user session.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the interface. Will be used to identify an HR view from a Service view.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the department as stored by knowledge and will be used for striping questions.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code and used to differentiate between applications such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: QUERY_SOURCE
columns.description: The query source stores how the document was accessed.

columns.name: QUESTION_TEXT
columns.description: This is the text of the search question.

columns.name: REQUEST_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the creation of the row in the request action capture table.

columns.name: STAT_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the stat occurred for the question.

columns.name: NORMALIZED_QUESTION_ID
columns.description: The unique ID used to track the text for a given normalized question.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.description: The Question ID associated with a question helps to uniquely identify the questions when used with the Session ID.

columns.name: RESPONSE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of responses returned for a given question. The question can be an actual or normalized question.

columns.name: UNKNOWN_WORD_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unknown words that are not configured in search application.

columns.name: CONCEPT_MATCH_COUNT
columns.description: Number of known words or concepts that are configured in search application.

columns.name: SEARCH_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: The Search Transaction ID associated with a question which helps to uniquely identify the question.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SEARCH_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: For entries that come from paginations and facet searches, the original search transaction id will point to the original question.

columns.name: SEARCH_CONFIGURATION
columns.description: Determines if the search comes from elastic search or is a BERT based search.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FILTERS
columns.description: The list of product prefilters used to filter search results.

columns.name: CATEGORY_FILTERS
columns.description: The list of category prefilters used to filter search results.

columns.name: DOC_TYPE_FILTERS
columns.description: The list of document type prefilters used to filter search results.

columns.name: USER_GROUP_FILTERS
columns.description: The list of user group prefilters used to filter search results.

columns.name: SEARCH_EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: The search event type determines what kind of event triggered the search action.

columns.name: SEARCH_ORIGIN
columns.description: The value of the x-km-searchorigin header parameter when a search query is submitted.
